items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I told her that I was getting it from Lena Horne's father, Teddy Horne

ctx.x: Now, I knew...I knew how to live...I knew, just like I say, I knew women and I knew that a woman would be nice to you, 'specially if she's older than you, or something like that. And I had to use that. And there were five guys with us and then they looked at me like I was a father, you know, I was the champion of the band... and I'd go out and get money and food and tailor shop and...we were living pretty good in Pittsburgh.

And finally one day my wife, who was very, very jealous, asked me, "Where are you getting this money?" And I told her that I was getting it from Lena Horne's father, Teddy Horne, who lived in Pittsburgh. She followed me one night to this woman's house and she was yellin' all over the place, she was going to kill the woman and kill me and kill herself and all that. We ended up no food, you know, back (laughter)...we ended up back where we started from, you know what I mean, on zero.

Well, a show came through, and as I said, they always need people. So we got on the show and went from Pittsburgh to Washington and then in Washington that show broke up. Then we got on another show and went from Washington to Baltimore and back. We just...nothing was consistent, nothing was real, you know, it was...I tried one time to become a comedian in Washington. So they said, "Yeah, we need a comedian"...that's why they needed that other person...more than one person. So I got on the show in Washington and…
